## Name & positioning
- Product name: LeaseCraft
- One-line value: LeaseCraft produces plain-English lease clauses for common situations — late rent, pets, deposits — state-aware and drop-in ready. It is a template, not legal advice.
- Domain: https://leasecraft.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## FAQ
Q1. What is LeaseCraft?
A1. LeaseCraft generates plain-English lease clauses for situations like late rent, pets, and deposits, state-aware and drop-in ready.
Q2. Which clauses does it cover?
A2. Common situations such as late rent, pets, and deposits.
Q3. Is it legal advice?
A3. No. It is a template, not legal advice; review with counsel before use.
Q4. Does it cover my state?
A4. It uses state-aware framing so the language fits your location's context.
Q5. Who is it for?
A5. Landlords and tenants who want readable clause language to drop into an agreement.
Q6. Are both sides covered?
A6. It provides landlord and tenant sides for the clause.
